description_fill_in: Unique ID of the source document in the corpus (DOC001 to DOC050). Many chunks can belong to one document.
File format of the source document. Five values: PDF, Word, TXT, HTML, Markdown. Decides which loader is used while ingesting.
Unique ID of one text chunk (CHK00001 to CHK05000). A chunk is a small piece of a document that is embedded and stored in the vector database.
Number of words in the chunk. Range 50 to 500. Very small chunks may miss context and very large chunks may add noise to the retrieved context.
Cosine similarity between the query embedding and the chunk embedding. Range 0.50 to 1.00. Higher means the chunk is more relevant to the query.
Kind of question asked: factual, procedural, comparative, analytical or summarization. Used to compare how the system performs on different question styles.
Quality of the generated answer on a 0 to 1 scale (range 0.60 to 1.00), e.g. from human or LLM-judge rating of correctness and faithfulness to the source chunk. Higher is better.
